outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter plots with individual mice (black dots for NC, red squares for HFD) plotted alongside mean ± S.D. bars.
Panel B shows representative gross photographic images of mice, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O staining micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D shows a representative dot blot and methylene blue staining image, not a plot of averaged values.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification is shown as a bar graph with individual data points (dots) for each mouse overlaid on the mean ± S.D. bars.

While the top of panel F shows representative western blot images (not a plot), the bottom quantification graph of TET1/TET2/TET3 ratios displays individual data points for each animal alongside the mean ± S.D. bars.
